limitations.codeclone: Real FEMPD methods and original EvoSuite source recovered; differential suites regenerated/augmented, not historical CodeWalk admission suites.
limitations.bugfixing: Real original patches/tests/commits, only locally admitted repositories; native Windows Python environment differs from initial container images.
limitations.verus: Real algorithms and upstream reference proofs; modules/extra fixed wrappers, matched executable token projection, different toolchain; conservative i32-vector L10 subset.
limitations.bigo: Restricted extraction from 4900 actual CodeComplex programs; program-label agreement plus limited AST audit, empirical size fits; no cubic/np atoms, historical pool not recovered.

notes: Shared source components are intentional; this is not an independent unseen-source test split.
Reference-label controls are not model evaluation results.
